review_locator: PMCID:PMC3837245, NLRC5, at the Heart of Antigen Presentation; PMCID:PMC8250149, NLRC5: A Potential Target for Central Nervous System Disorders
primary_title: The nucleotide-binding oligomerization domain-like receptor NLRC5 is involved in IFN-dependent antiviral immune responses
decision_basis: The reviews identify IFN-responsive STAT1 control of NLRC5 transcription through promoter GAS elements; the cited primary analyzes IFN-dependent NLRC5 promoter activity and JAK/STAT1 dependence in human fibroblasts, HeLa and hematopoietic systems.
limitations_preserved: Promoter and pathway-dependence evidence support a bounded IFN-responsive STAT1-to-NLRC5 gene bridge; preserve stimulus/cell context and distinguish NLRC5 transcription from NLRC5 protein, MHC-I enhanceosome assembly or SCI function, with no terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC9241385, Spotlight on TAP and its vital role in antigen presentation; PMCID:PMC2774226, Cross-regulation of Signaling and Immune Responses by IFN-gamma and STAT1
primary_title: Synergistic induction of the Tap-1 gene by IFN-gamma and lipopolysaccharide in macrophages is regulated by STAT1
decision_basis: The reviews identify STAT1 control of the IFN-responsive Tap1/LMP2 bidirectional promoter through GAS/ISRE elements; the cited primary tests promoter elements and STAT1 dependence in macrophage-like cells.
limitations_preserved: Promoter mutagenesis and STAT1-dependent induction support a bounded myeloid Tap1 gene bridge; preserve the bidirectional promoter and IFN-gamma/LPS context, and distinguish TAP1 transcript from transporter protein, antigen presentation or SCI function, with no terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Distinct regulatory mechanisms control proinflammatory cytokines IL-18 and IL-1beta
decision_basis: The review identifies type-I interferon, STAT1 and IRF9/ISGF3-associated regulation of IL18; the cited primary shows Il18 induction depends on IFNAR, Stat1 and Irf9 in stimulated macrophages.
limitations_preserved: Genetic dependency supports a bounded type-I-IFN/STAT1/IRF9-associated IL18 gene bridge; this is not purified ISGF3 promoter binding and does not establish pro-IL-18 processing, bioactive secretion, SCI function or terminal-TF output.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC5286482, Inflammation and Cancer: Extra- and Intracellular Determinants of Tumor-Associated Macrophages as Tumor Promoters; PMCID:PMC5912892, Macrophages and the Recovery from Acute and Chronic Inflammation
primary_title: A transcriptional network regulating CCL18 expression in human macrophages
decision_basis: The reviews identify STAT3/STAT6/BATF control of macrophage CCL18 transcription; the cited primary demonstrates factor occupancy, promoter-element perturbation and cytokine-dependent CCL18 expression in human macrophages.
limitations_preserved: Cooperative occupancy and CRISPRi/knockdown evidence support a bounded human macrophage CCL18 gene bridge; distinguish CCL18 transcription from secreted chemokine abundance, receptor signaling or SCI effects, with no terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: https://academic.oup.com/jleukbio/article/109/1/143/6884597, Molecular interactions and functions of IL-32; PMCID:PMC4074809, STAT3 target genes relevant to human cancers
primary_title: Intracellular interaction of interleukin (IL)-32alpha with PKCepsilon and STAT3 protein augments IL-6 production in THP-1 promonocytic cells
decision_basis: The reviews identify an IL-32alpha/PKCepsilon/STAT3 complex that enhances IL6 promoter activity; the cited primary measures STAT3 S727, promoter occupancy/reporter activity, IL6 mRNA and protein in THP-1 cells.
limitations_preserved: Promoter occupancy/reporter and transcript evidence support a bounded intracellular IL-32alpha/PKCepsilon/STAT3-to-IL6 gene bridge; preserve overexpression/PMA context and distinguish IL6 transcription from secreted IL-6 protein, IL-6 receptor signaling, SCI effects or terminal-TF output.
